metadata.description: Agent skill for generating reviewable single-file HTML artifacts — RFCs, design docs, code reviews, postmortems, ADRs, specs

plugins.name: html-artifact
plugins.description: Editorial style guide for one-off, single-file reviewable HTML artifacts (RFCs, design docs, code reviews, postmortems, ADRs, plans) — NOT for production web apps or customer-facing UIs. Single self-contained file with section-reviewed checkboxes, per-section comments, decision queue, text-range annotations, baseline export formats, and a JSON companion file on disk for live agent monitoring
